inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash flow statement 'Share-based payments expenses' RMB19,989k (3939.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:3989) and H1 FY2026 / H1 FY2025 interim equivalents (14,932k / 8,763k); TTM = 19.989 + 14.932 - 8.763. No equity-award taxes disclosed (options settled by issue).
inputs.share_count_basis: Issued shares ex-treasury ~4,404m at 30 June 2026 (derived from the 2024 Share Award Scheme disclosure: 370,435,880 shares available = 8.41% of issued shares ex-treasury; 21,963,000 treasury shares held) plus the 31.2m dilutive effect of the 54.575m outstanding options from the H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS note (4,453.6m weighted diluted less 4,422.4m weighted basic). Post 4-for-1 subdivision of 25 Nov 2025. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; the H1 FY2026 buyback (RMB191.1m) is the cash mechanism funding the flat count.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. Per-share values computed in CNY and multiplied by CNY->HKD 1.1749 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-23). No dual listing for a parity check; cross-check against the company's own conversion of the H1 FY2026 interim dividend (HK$6.00 cents = RMB5.21 cents, implying 1.152 at the August 2026 declaration date) - direction and magnitude agree, the 2% gap is CNY appreciation since August. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-derive it at the next rebuild.
inputs.fy0: TTM to 30 June 2026 (FY2025 + H1 FY2026 - H1 FY2025)
inputs.net_cash_note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet (interim, RMB m): bank balances and cash 498.3 + term deposits 170.3 + financial assets at FVTPL 1,683.5 (structured products ~943.6 and money-market funds, all current, RMB1,537m redeemed in H1 so treated as cash-like) = 2,352.1; less bank borrowings 123.3 (secured 83.3 + unsecured 40.0, all <1yr, 3.91%), lease liabilities 2.5 (1.15 current + 1.38 non-current), consideration payable to former NCI shareholder 38.1 = 163.9. Net cash 2,188.2. Because the FVTPL pile is added to EV, the income it earns is stripped from FCF: TTM bank interest + FVTPL interest/dividend income ~RMB70m (FY2025 interest received 58.2m; H1 FY2026 bank 8.0 + FVTPL interest 16.2 + FVTPL dividends 6.1 = 30.3m; less ~15m for H1 FY2025). Realised FVTPL gains sit in investing cash flow, not OCF, so need no further strip.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are RMB; WACC built in CNY: 10y CGB ~1.8% + ERP 6.5% x beta 1.2 = CoE ~9.6%; debt is 2% of capital at 3.9%, so WACC ~9.5%. Used identically across all three scenarios - operating, price and jurisdiction risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights (risk charged once). Note that ~75-80% of revenue is USD gold, so a CNY rate slightly understates the USD-equivalent discount rate; the 9.5% is at the upper end of HK-listed China-gold-miner sell-side WACCs (8-9.5%) for that reason and for Solomon Islands sovereign risk, not as a scenario-risk premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: RMB2.5m lease liabilities in net debt; no principal deducted from flows (lease payments RMB0.7m/half, immaterial).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows made attributable-only via the leakage embedded in cash_tax_rate_path (tax + the 11.8% minority share of Gold Ridge after-tax profit). NCI (RMB541m book at 30 June 2026) is NOT deducted in the bridge - book NCI vastly understates the economic value of 11.8% of the mine that drives 80% of profit, so the flows route is the only honest one. Calibration: TTM attributable profit 1,659 / TTM PBT 2,638 = 62.9%, i.e. 37.1% accrual leakage, which is the mature rate in every scenario's path; FY2025 was 35.4%, H1 FY2026 30.1%.
inputs.tax_note: Statutory: Solomon Islands 35% on Gold Ridge, PRC 25% (Yifeng Wanguo/Xinzhuang 15% HNTE preference through 2026). Accrual ETR 28.6% FY2025, 23.3% H1 FY2026. CASH taxes lag badly: RMB200m paid in FY2025 on RMB2,096m PBT (9.6%) because the Gold Ridge build is being deducted as incurred. The leakage path therefore starts below the mature 37% (28% Y1, 31% Y2, 34% Y3) and reaches 37% by Y4 as the capital-allowance shelter is consumed - the shelter is NOT perpetuated.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, cyclical/non-US adaptations applied: CNY-built WACC, CNY->HKD fx bridge, leases as debt, NCI via leakage, excluded investment income matched by the FVTPL/deposit assets in the bridge). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md: a producing gold/copper miner is an operating company, not a bank/REIT/LIC. MINING ADAPTATIONS: (1) commodity price normalised to mid-cycle in the base case - realised ~US$3,900/contained oz in H1 FY2026 (RMB1,379.5m on 1,522kg = 48.9koz) against spot ~US$4,030 on 2026-10-23; base assumes US$3,500/oz long-run (bear US$2,800, bull US$4,200), applied through the growth and margin paths rather than a flat margin; (2) reserve-life-aware terminal: Gold Ridge reserves 7.78Moz (SLR, 31 Dec 2025) support 24-30 years at the modelled 255-330koz/yr, so a perpetuity is tolerable but the terminal cap is set at 11x FCF (a 25-30yr annuity at 9.5% is 9.4-9.8x; the extra turn credits conversion of the 12.97Moz resource base and Xinzhuang/Walege) and terminal growth is 0.5-1.5% (no real volume growth beyond the expansion); (3) capex supercycle modelled explicitly: TTM capex RMB1,461m (39% of revenue), remaining commitments RMB1,457m at 30 June 2026, so capex%% runs 40%/20%/11% in Y1-Y3 before settling at 7-8% sustaining, and D&A%% rises from 3.5% toward 6% as the new plant depreciates. FY0 is the TTM to 30 June 2026 so the flows match the June balance sheet and the post-subdivision share count. Buybacks: RMB191.1m in H1 FY2026 (repurchaser; the flat count is funded). The July 2026 Gold Ridge landslide (fatalities among informal miners per press, 'no injuries' per the interim) is carried in the bear weight (30%), not in a WACC premium.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR (TTM RMB3,784m to ~RMB7,350m): mid-cycle gold at US$3,500/oz on a ~2.5x volume ramp to ~255koz by FY2030
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Historical CAGRs are not usable as forward rates: FY2017-FY2022 revenue included a since-discontinued electrolytic-copper trading business (FY2020-21 spikes), Gold Ridge only began commercial output in 2023, equity growth includes RMB1.26bn (FY2024) and RMB0.67bn (FY2025) of placements, and the FY2022->FY2025 FCF CAGR is undefined because FY2022 owner FCF was negative. Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less investment income, RMB m): FY2020 33.9, FY2021 -86.0, FY2022 -15.9, FY2023 188.5, FY2024 639.1, FY2025 792.0, TTM Jun-26 337.3 (capex-depressed).
historical_growth.notes: SBC is immaterial (0.5-0.7% of revenue, first charged FY2025) so reported and owner-FCF CAGRs do not diverge on SBC; the owner-FCF haircut is almost entirely the investment-income strip on the RMB2.35bn cash/FVTPL pile.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 (TTM to Jun-27): gold mean-reverts from the H1 FY2026 realised ~US$3,900 toward US$3,500 while volume holds ~100-105koz (plant at 90% utilisation, stockpile exhausted) -> -8%. Y2-Y3: ball/SAG mill commissioning lifts processed ore from ~3.3Mtpa toward ~7Mtpa; contained gold sold ~160koz then ~220koz at US$3,500 x 90% payability x 7.15 CNY/USD. Y4-Y5: ~250-255koz (70% of the 10Mtpa plan, an execution haircut) plus Xinzhuang ~RMB950-975m at mid-cycle copper. Y6-Y10: no real volume growth; 1-2% nominal.
base.margin_rationale: TTM EBITDA margin ~73% at ~US$3,900 realised; at US$3,500 the Gold Ridge gross margin falls from 80.7% to ~78% and the group EBITDA margin to ~68%. Held 67-68% through the ramp (scale offsets lower grade in expansion ore), then eases to 64% in Y8-Y10 for rising strip ratio and grade decline typical of a maturing open pit.
base.capex_rationale: RMB1,457m committed at 30 June 2026 (secondary hydropower station, mills, 35kV substation, heap-leach/tailings) on top of RMB780m spent in H1 FY2026: Y1 ~RMB1,400m (40%), Y2 ~RMB900m (20%), Y3 ~RMB640m (11%), then 7-8% sustaining (deferred stripping, tailings lifts, fleet) against D&A of 6%.

bull.growth_rationale: Gold holds ~US$4,200/oz (near the 2026-10 spot of ~US$4,030, consistent with management's US$4,500 upside case); the full 10Mtpa plant is commissioned on schedule in 2027 and reaches ~330koz/yr by Y4-Y5 (Y5 revenue ~RMB9.2bn: 330koz x 0.9 x 4,200 x 7.15 + Xinzhuang ~RMB1bn); Walege lead (51%) and Xinzhuang's 1.0Mtpa step-up add 2-4% nominal growth in Y6-Y10.

bear.growth_rationale: Gold retraces to US$2,800/oz by Y2 (management's own resilient-growth / rising-yield downside, ~30% below spot, still above the 2024 average); a repeat of the 2026 arson/landslide incidents forces a multi-month stoppage and a Solomon Islands response (tighter mine-area control, higher royalty/export duty) that delays commissioning; the expansion stalls at ~5.5Mtpa, ~170koz/yr by Y4 (Y5 revenue ~RMB4.0bn). Committed capex is spent anyway (44%/26%/13%), so Y1-Y2 owner FCF is near zero.

scenario_narratives.base: Wanguo is now a single-asset gold story: Gold Ridge (88.2% owned, Solomon Islands) is ~75% of revenue at an 80% gross margin, Xinzhuang copper-zinc-sulfur the rest. The base case takes gold back to a US$3,500/oz mid-cycle (13% below the 2026-10 spot and ~10% below the H1 FY2026 realised price), so Y1 revenue falls 8% before the 10Mtpa expansion (ball mill 80% / SAG mill 50% installed at June 2026, RMB1.46bn still committed) lifts contained gold sold from ~100koz to ~255koz by FY2030 - a 70% execution haircut to the plan. Capex absorbs most of the cash through Y3 (40%/20%/11% of revenue), after which the mine throws off ~RMB2.5bn/yr of attributable owner FCF at 68% EBITDA margins and a 37% tax+minority leakage. Terminal value is capped at 11x FCF with 1% growth to respect a ~30-year reserve life. RMB2.19bn of net cash (incl. RMB1.68bn of structured products) is added once, with its income stripped from the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: Gold holds US$4,200 (management's framing: dollar weakness, central-bank and PBoC buying, Fed cuts) and the Zijin-affiliated technical team delivers the full 10Mtpa plant in 2027, reaching ~330koz/yr by FY2029-30; 72% EBITDA margins, Walege lead and the Xinzhuang 1.0Mtpa step-up add growth in the back half, and the resource base (12.97Moz) converts to extend mine life beyond the 11x terminal cap. Even so, the bull value sits below the current price - the market is pricing spot gold in perpetuity plus a flawless ramp, or a discount rate well under 9.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2026 incidents at Gold Ridge (January arson of >10 machines, the July fatal landslide involving informal miners that the interim called 'no injuries') escalate into a sustained security and landowner conflict and a tougher Solomon Islands fiscal/regulatory stance, delaying commissioning and capping throughput near 5.5Mtpa; gold simultaneously retraces to US$2,800 as real yields rise. Committed capex is still spent, so FY2027-28 owner FCF is close to zero and the business settles at ~RMB1.2bn/yr of FCF on 54-58% margins. No solvency issue - net cash covers the remaining build - but the equity is worth a third of today's price.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: single-mine concentration in a frontier jurisdiction with recurring fatal incidents and property destruction in 2025-26, spot gold at a record after a 2026 spike-and-retreat, and no hedging. Bull cut to 20% because it needs two independent things to go right - gold staying above US$4,000 AND a 3x throughput ramp on schedule in a remote location. Base 50% carries the central mid-cycle-price / partial-ramp view.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the mine on mid-cycle gold, not spot; charge the expansion capex explicitly before crediting the volume it buys; charge the 11.8% Gold Ridge minority and the 35% Solomon Islands tax through the flows; add the cash and structured-product pile once with its income stripped; and cap the terminal value for a finite (if long) reserve life. The house number is in CNY converted to HKD at a dated rate so it is comparable with the HKEX quote.
key_risks_to_valuation: Gold price: every US$500/oz on ~255koz is ~RMB820m of revenue and ~RMB500m of attributable FCF, roughly HK$1.3/share of value at the base multiple
Expansion execution and timing of the 10Mtpa plant (commissioning slips push RMB2bn+/yr of FCF out a year each)
Gold Ridge security, landowner and informal-mining conflict; the July 2026 landslide disclosure gap is a governance flag
Solomon Islands fiscal/regulatory tightening (35% CIT, royalties, export duty) and sovereign/geopolitical sensitivity of a Chinese-owned strategic asset
Cash-tax normalisation: FY2025 cash taxes were 9.6% of PBT; the model assumes the shelter is gone by Y4
Capital allocation: buybacks and dividends alongside RMB1.5bn/yr capex; RMB1.68bn sits in structured products whose principal protection is not disclosed
FX: value is CNY-built against an HKD quote and USD gold; the 1.1749 rate is dated 2026-10-23 and is not refreshed by price updates

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 6.96-18.69 HKD; CNY->HKD from Yahoo CNYHKD=X same date
